name: LAMDA Development S.A.
summary: Lamda Development S.A., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the investment in, development, and project management activities in the commercial real estate market in Greece and internationally. Its development portfolio includes shopping and leisure centers, office complexes, airport areas, residencies, hotels, shopping centers, offices, cultural and training centers, information and health centers, and other infrastructure projects. The company was founded in 1977 and is based in Marousi, Greece.
